eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Chesapeake; Hampton; Norfolk; Suffolk; Virginia Beach, VA; at 10:55 PM on AUG 15, 2024 Effective until 11:55 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
The Virginia State Police and the Virginia Missing Children Clearinghouse have issued an AMBER Alert on behalf of the Virginia Beach City Police Department, for multiple child abductions that occurred on August 14th, 2024 at 2048 hours.
The children are believed to be in extreme danger and was last seen at Jay Are Court in Virginia Beach, Virginia.
Abducted are: (1) Zayir Plummer, age 5, black male, black hair, brown eyes, height 4' 0", 100 pounds. He was last seen wearing grey pants and a black jacket; (2) Zayin Plummer, age 7, black male, black hair, brown eyes, height 4' 0", 100 pounds. He was last seen wearing rust-colored pants and a light blue shirt; and (3) Zariyah Plummer, age 16 months, black female, black hair, brown eyes, height 24 inches, 40 pounds. She was last seen wearing pink tights and a Trolls dress. 
The children are believed to have been abducted by Dana Demetrius Plummer, age 36, black male, brown hair, brown eyes, 5' 9" height, 170 pounds.  No clothing description was given by investigating agency.
They may be in a black 2024 Honda Passport SUV with temporary plates 37550R with an unknown direction
For further information contact the Virginia Beach City Police Department at 757/385-5000 or visit https://vsp.virginia.gov/active-alerts/
